findings.evidence: Perm/Basic.lean has only `isCycleOn_setOf_sameCycle` (194) and `isCycleOn_preimage_quotientMk` (225), with no fibre-of-a-map version. SumCongr.lean:130-146 already provides the Sum SameCycle API that the PR re-derives through `cases d with | inl | inr`.
findings.fix: Add once in Perm/Basic: `theorem isCycleOn_preimage_of_sameCycle_iff {f : α → β} (h : ∀ x y, σ.SameCycle x y ↔ f x = f y) (b : β) : σ.IsCycleOn (f ⁻¹' {b})`. Then state `sameCycle_ribbonRotB_iff` / `sameCycle_ribbonRotW_iff` using `sameCycle_sumCongr_inl/inr` and `not_sameCycle_sumCongr_inl_inr`, and derive all three IsCycleOn theorems from the new lemma.
findings.issue: `isCycleOn_rotation` (~101), `isCycleOn_ribbonRotB` (~181) and `isCycleOn_ribbonRotW` (~211) each rebuild the same `⟨⟨mapsTo, injOn, surjOn⟩, sameCycle⟩` proof, and the last two redo the `Sum` case split by hand.

findings.evidence: All three helpers are `have h := (Perm.SameCycle.refl _ _).apply_right; cases b <;> cases b' <;> first | exact .refl _ _ | simpa using h`. `Function.Involutive.sameCycle_iff` is at Perm/Basic.lean:503.
findings.fix: Prove once: `(Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl α) Equiv.boolNot).SameCycle (a, b) (a', b') ↔ a = a'` (via `Function.Involutive.sameCycle_iff`). Combined with the Sum lemmas, this replaces all three helpers.
findings.issue: The private lemmas `sameCycle_ribbonRotB_circle`, `sameCycle_ribbonRotW_interval` and `sameCycle_ribbonRotW_circle` have the same proof. Each is an instance of one fact about `prodCongr (refl α) boolNot`.

summary: The ribbon-graph adapter's statements sit at a reasonable level, but its fibre-cycle proofs and Bool-swap helpers each repeat one argument instead of proving it once in general. Factor out the general lemmas and derive the instances.
